POWER.anchoring_note: Dielectric center plus half nominal PCB thickness defines the F outer plane. Native STEP component offset above copper is preserved; mask is not a STEP solid.

SHIELD.anchoring_note: Front foil outer face anchored to the lower screen contact plane. Body plus single foil thickness measured from STEP.

LOGIC.anchoring_note: Dielectric center plus half nominal PCB thickness defines the F outer plane. Native STEP component offset above copper is preserved; mask is not a STEP solid.

coordinate_convention: CAD X = native PCB X; CAD Y = −physical PCB Y; CAD Z points up. LOGIC and SHIELD rotate 180° about X.

pcb_intersections.method: Native BRep Boolean of every overlapping solid pair (24); disjoint pairs rejected by bounding boxes. Volume sum is conservative if solids overlap internally.
Disjoint axis-aligned bounding boxes prove no intersection.

vertical_envelope_clearances.note: Long header pins cross the screen through declared NPTH holes; a negative whole-export gap is expected. Ordinary component clearance and full BRep intersections are checked separately. Undocumented NiceNano, SMA and modem models remain approximate.
